description: Phase 2 native client runtime inventory, including metadata-only variant/BOM components checked by Gradle. Exact-version published Maven POM license declarations reviewed; Guava inherits its parent POM. All 43 embedded AndroidX LICENSE texts match the Apache text after trailing newline normalization. OkHttp public suffix NOTICE and MPL-2.0, DataStore shaded protobuf BSD-3-Clause, and Kotlin upstream license/NOTICE are retained. No separate legal files were present in the other resolved archives. Kotlin upstream NOTICE is retained verbatim, including its compiler distribution heading.
